jobs.title: VP of Marketing
jobs.description:
VP of Marketing

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The role

This is a rare opportunity to shape a category-defining marketing engine for a platform at the forefront of AI. You’ll lead how Prolific is positioned and adopted by frontier AI labs and enterprise customers, while continuing to scale our research business and global participant ecosystem.

At a pivotal stage of growth, this is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll define and execute a clear, commercially-driven marketing strategy that strengthens our enterprise B2B motion, sharpens our market positioning, and drives pipeline and revenue.

You’ll build, evolve, and lead a globally distributed team across the full breadth of marketing, including enterprise B2B (core focus), product marketing, brand, growth, and marketing operations- alongside B2C growth for our participant ecosystem.

This role requires a balance of strategic thinking and execution: someone who can operate at a high level while also rolling up their sleeves to build, test, and scale what works.

What you’ll be doing in the role

- Set and execute an integrated marketing strategy aligned to company goals, with a strong focus on enterprise B2B growth

- Build, restructure, and scale the marketing organisation, including team design and operating model

- Establish rigorous performance management across demand generation and growth: pipeline, attribution, CAC/LTV, expansion, and ROI

- Develop and scale a high-performing B2B demand engine (ABM, field marketing, enterprise GTM) targeting AI labs and large organisations

- Lead product marketing and positioning, creating clear, differentiated narratives across a complex product and customer landscape

- Partner closely with sales to strengthen sales enablement and land-and-expand motions

- Drive cross-functional go-to-market execution, including launches and expansion into new customer segments

- Build Prolific’s brand awareness and category presence, ensuring we are top-of-mind for AI and research leaders

What you’ll bring to the role

- 10+ years leading and scaling marketing in high-growth tech or scale-up environments

- Proven ownership of a full-stack B2B marketing function, spanning multiple disciplines

- Track record of building and executing strategies that drive pipeline and revenue growth

- Experience operating in enterprise B2B environments, ideally with complex or technical products

- Exposure to AI, developer, or data-driven ecosystems strongly preferred

Skills and Approach

- Deep B2B marketing expertise, particularly in demand generation, ABM, and enterprise GTM

- Ability to translate complex products and markets into clear, differentiated positioning

- Strong understanding of sales enablement and land-and-expand models

- Commercial and analytical mindset, with a focus on pipeline, revenue, and ROI

- Comfortable operating at both strategic and hands-on levels in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

- Builder mindset, with experience creating structure and processes from first principles

- Evolve marketing to be more AI-forward and scalable, leveraging new tools and approaches to increase speed, insight, and impact across the team

Leadership

- Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing, multi-disciplinary teams

- Experience overseeing product marketing and brand, even if not your core background

- Strong operator who brings clarity, structure, and alignment to complex organisations

- Comfortable acting as a builder and change agent, not just an optimiser

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Lifecycle Marketing Manager- 3 month FTC

Team: Marketing

Prolific

At Prolific, our marketplace is rooted in academia, and that commitment runs deep. Alongside our work to accelerate the future of AI, we’re continuing to redefine how the world conducts academic research.

What started as a research-driven idea has evolved into the world’s most trusted infrastructure for human data. Today, tens of thousands of researchers from top universities across the globe rely on Prolific to power their work, from peer-reviewed studies to the next generation of technological breakthroughs.

We're doubling down on our mission to serve the academic community, deepening relationships, building smarter tools, and making high-quality human data more accessible than ever.

The role

Prolific’s self-serve motion is a core growth engine for Prolific. We’re looking for an experienced lifecycle marketer to scale and ship the foundations of our lifecycle programme: onboarding, activation, retention and reactivation across email and in-app, plus the product-qualified signals that tell Sales which accounts are worth a conversation.

You’ll work with Product, Customer Success, Sales/RevOps and Product Marketing. We need someone who can get up to speed quickly, make sound calls with minimal direction, and deliver programmes, dashboards and documentation.

This is not a traditional B2B SaaS marketing role. We’re looking for someone who has run lifecycle in a product-led, self-serve business, where users sign up and start on their own and marketing’s job is to drive behaviour in and around the product. Demand gen, MQL/SQL pipeline, events and sales-led nurture are not the right background.

This is a full-time, 3 month fixed-term contract, with the potential to extend depending on business needs.

What you’ll bring to the role

- 5-7 years in lifecycle, CRM, retention or growth marketing at a product-led / self-serve company , with a track record of moving activation, retention or expansion metrics (not just sending campaigns)

- Prior contract, consulting or agency experience, or a clear record of delivering scoped work independently to a deadline

- Hands-on ownership of lifecycle programmes for a freemium, free-trial or pay-as-you-go funnel

- Strong experience with email/CRM platforms (HubSpot or equivalent) and in-product messaging tools (Pendo, Appcues, Intercom, Braze, Customer.io , Iterable or similar)

- Experience defining activation, building behavioural segments and triggers, and using product usage data to drive messaging

- Analytical fluency: cohort analysis, activation and retention curves, funnel conversion, LTV. You can run your own analysis in HubSpot/Hex or equivalent without a data team

- Experience designing and running experiments, and knowing which results to trust

- Experience partnering with Sales/RevOps on PQL or usage-based handoff

- A clear communicator who can prioritise, push back and manage stakeholders without needing close supervision

- Comfortable with ambiguity in a small, high-output team

What you’ll be doing in the role

Month 1: Diagnose and prioritise

- Audit current lifecycle programmes, journeys, segmentation and tooling (HubSpot, Pendo, Hex)

- Map the self-serve journey by customer segment and identify the biggest activation and retention gaps

- Agree a prioritised roadmap and success metrics with Growth Marketing, Product and Customer Success

- Ship at least one quick win, such as a fix to an existing onboarding email or in-app message

Months 2-4: Build and launch and document

- Design, build and launch onboarding and activation programmes across email and in-app (Pendo), aimed at faster time to first value

- Launch retention, top-up and reactivation/win-back flows for lapsed and dormant users

- Define PQL and expansion signals with Sales/RevOps: behavioural thresholds, validation against conversion outcomes, and a CRM handoff process

- Start a structured experimentation programme across onboarding, email and in-app

- Report on results, learnings and experiment outcomes

- Document journeys, segmentation logic, triggers, PQL definitions, naming conventions and

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Strategic Customer Success Manager

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space — we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that is reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.  Our Strategic Sales and Success team works with most of the world’s leading frontier AI model creators on one of their highest priority initiatives.

The role

As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will partner with frontier AI model creators who are making headline news every day, ensuring they achieve breakthrough value through our human data offerings.  In this role, you will lead adoption, consumption, development, and value realization as a trusted advisor for AI research, program management, and business stakeholders.  You will own the end-to-end success lifecycle, guiding customers from onboarding to maturity, expansion, renewal, and advocacy while collaborating with your counterparts on Prolific’s Services, Support, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, and other teams.

What you’ll bring to the role

- 6+ years in a customer-facing strategic or enterprise customer success (and/or leadership) role, ideally in a business where value is aligned with increased consumption

- Experience developing strategic success plans and orchestrating cross-functional dynamics to drive positive outcomes with customers

- Operational rigor and experience forecasting consumption to identify opportunities, mitigate risk, and measure growth

- Demonstrated success with navigating large organizations, driving adoption and expansion, and cultivating executive relationships/sponsorship

- Strong business acumen and ability to interface with senior customer stakeholders (C-Suite, VP, research leads) as well as technical teams (engineers, data scientists, product owners)

- Fundamental understanding of AI, machine learning, LLMs, or similar concepts—enough to speak credibly about research use cases and value levers

- Desire to play an influential role in a rapidly growing, innovative business—contributing, sharing ideas and expertise, and helping elevate the team around you

What you’ll be doing in the role

- Partnering with frontier AI model creators to ensure the success of their research initiatives, human data/feedback programs, and quality assurance benchmarks

- Serving as a trusted advisor—translating research and business objectives into actionable strategies for Prolific’s platform and services to achieve

- Lead business reviews and executive engagements with clients, building case studies and advocacy stories that highlight how Prolific is driving frontier AI research for them

- Drive continuous improvement of success playbooks, processes, and customer-facing resources, replicating best practices in usage-based models and research workflows

- Spending time face-to-face with customers and with peers in the San Francisco office—collaborating, learning, and growing together in service of shared outcomes

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.
